evals.prompt: Audit my project memory for stale entries. Some cite PRs that already merged.
evals.expected_output: Read-only classification of each memory file with archive/keep/update/flag verdicts, proposing before changing.
assertions: Auto-detects the memory dir and MEMORY.md index
Validates PR, SHA, branch and file:line cites against the repo
Archives project-type entries whose cited PR is MERGED, and archives entries citing missing branches or files
Keeps type: feedback, reference and user entries even if the origin PR merged
Edits project entries that still say open or WIP after merge to mark merged with the SHA
Read-only by default: proposes and waits for confirmation before moving anything

evals.prompt: Prune the memory folder, just delete the old stuff.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to hard-delete and archives instead.
assertions: Never deletes a memory file; moves it to memory/archive/<date>-<file>.md
Does not archive in a single pass without user confirmation
Updates the MEMORY.md index and reindexes RAG after confirmed changes

evals.prompt: Save a note that the deploy now needs the new env var.
evals.expected_output: Writing a new memory belongs to sync-memories, not pruning.
assertions: Does not audit or archive existing memory
